fact: The CNEF will officially launch the financial mediation scheme on 26 October 2026; a financial mediator was appointed by order published 10 June 2026 to settle disputes with banks, microfinance and payment providers including mobile money, under CEMAC regulation 01/20 and a Prime Minister decree of 21 March 2024 and orders of 7 January 2025.
title: Médiation financière : le Gabon lance officiellement son dispositif le 26 octobre
